answer: A jet engine pulls air in, squeezes it, burns fuel in it and shoots the hot gas out the back.
title: How a jet engine works
intro: I can see pictures of jets. This page does not explain their engines, so here is one, built part by part.
summary: Air in, squeeze, burn, spin, push.

parts.label: Casing
parts.say: The casing holds everything and guides the air.

parts.label: Fan
parts.say: The big fan at the front pulls air in.

parts.label: Compressor
parts.say: Rows of small blades squeeze the air tight.

parts.label: Combustor
parts.say: Fuel sprays into the squeezed air and burns.

parts.label: Turbine
parts.say: The hot gas spins the turbine, which turns the fan.

parts.label: Nozzle
parts.say: The gas shoots out the back and pushes the plane forward.
